'''The Hollows''' was the name given to the valley north of the [[Tythos Ridge]] and south of [[Kalikori village]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. It featured the entrance to the [[Upper Hollows]], a cave system where the native [[Flesh Raider]]s stored weapons.
